answer: That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate sonnet derivation per key. Because the atlas nonce is published only after close, the glacier audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 161 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
